text: Wicked Pocopoc unlocks a new outfit for Pocopoc. This item is a quest reward from Kismetric Disc.
Wild Argali are argali located throughout the Forbidden Reach.

The Wicked Tunnels are a portion of the tunnel system leading to Maraudon below Desolace. It consists of two different sections, both accessed from Zaetar's Choice. Taking the north tunnel from Zaetar's Choice leads to the upper Wicked Tunnels, a multi-leveled, maze-like tangle of tunnels and bridges filled with glowing purple crystals, earth elementals, and rock borers, and containing an instance portal to the Wicked Grotto in Maraudon. Taking the east tunnel from Zaetar's Choice through Earth Song Gate leads to the lower Wicked Tunnels, a much smaller and more straightforward area containing the instance portal to the Earth Song Falls.
Wild Crystalspines are crystalspines located in the Azure Span. When skinned, they can sometimes provide Crystalspine Fur,
Wild Argali Wool is obtained using the Aylaag Skinning Shear.

Wild Arcana is a PvP world quest at at the free-for-all Training Grounds of the Cobalt Assembly in north-central Azure Span. Much like forced-PvP world quests of past expansions, players can complete objectives by killing enemies in the area should there not be flesh-and-blood targets active.
Wielding Titanic Might becomes available at Renown level 13 with the Valdrakken Accord.
Wild Attunement is a Feral druid PvP talent, available at level 20.

Wild Blue Yonders are provided by Kirygosa to be delivered to Kai Wanderbrew, Ni Gentlepaw, Old Man Misteye, and Yol the Noodlemonger in Dawn's Blossom for Local Deliveries. Cultivated by Kiry, the villagers like them and use them for their dishes, brews, potions, or just as pleasant decorations.
Wild Blaze Hounds are core hounds located at the Molten Overflow in Zaralek Cavern.
Widow's Weep is created with Classic Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Widow's Weep.
Wild Bushfruits are looted from Wildsprings Shrubs in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Wild Gladiator's Dragonhide Tunic is sold by Cladd Dawnstrider in Warspear for .
__NOTOC__ Wild Steelbloom is a Herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (115), or can be bought in limited quantities from selected Vendors.
Wild Hunt is a pet talent available to all types of hunter pets.
Wild Leather is a collection of leather items. They are not considered to be a true set and there are no bonuses gained if you wear multiple items in this set.
Wild Shore is the southernmost coastline of the Eastern Kingdoms, and is home to the Bloodsail Buccaneers and their fleet. Gorlash can be found on an isle there.
Wild Grells are a grells who appear at Bashal'Aran in Darkshore.
Wild Gryphons are gryphons found in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Wild Shoulderpads are a quest reward from Leader of the Bloodscale.
Wild Horned Helm is mail head armor which is a quest reward from the quest Felling an Ancient Tree.

Wild Leather Vest is crafted with Leatherworking (225); previously learned from Pattern: Wild Leather Vest. The pattern is no longer obtainable, but it was not removed from the recipe lists of leatherworkers who'd already learned it.
Wild Leather Leggings are crafted with leatherworking (250); taught by Pattern: Wild Leather Leggings, once a quest reward from Wild Leather Leggings (quest).
Wild Leather Helmet is crafted with Leatherworking (225); taught by Pattern: Wild Leather Helmet.
The Wild Leather Cloak is crafted with Leatherworking (270); Taught by Pattern: Wild Leather Cloak.
Wild Leather Boots are crafted with Leatherworking (265); Taught by Pattern: Wild Leather Boots.
Wild Leather Shoulders are created with Leatherworking (225); taught by Pattern: Wild Leather Shoulders.
Wild Thornroot was a reagent for Rank 2 of the Druid spell Gift of the Wild.
Wild Quillvine was a reagent for the Druid spell, Gift of the Wild Rank 3.

The Wild Mantle is a hide crafted from some great natural beast, such as a wolf or bear, including the head, which forms a hood where the wearer sees through the animal's eyes. The mantle protects its bearer, but it seems to be alive as well, wishing to attack its bearer's enemies.
Wild Growth is a druid targeted AoE healing spell, healing up to 6 targets within 30 yards of the druid's current target. Incarnation: Tree of Life causes Wild Growth to heal an additional 2 targets.
__NOTOC__ Wild Mustard is a plant that can be found in the grassy areas of Dalaran.
Wild Winter Pilsner is the January brew from the Brew of the Month Club.
Wild Spineleaf was a reagent for the Druid spell, Gift of the Wild Rank 4.
:Made in the north of Kalimdor according to a traditional night elf recipe, these rice cakes showcase all the healthy, earthy goodness of natural ingredients.
__NOTOC__ Wild Turkeys are turkeys in Elwynn Forest and Tirisfal Glades during Pilgrim's Bounty.
Wild Horses are horses found in eastern Gilneas, eastern Hillsbrad Foothills, western Arathi Highlands, and the Battle for Stromgarde version of Arathi.
Wild Vortexes are unbound air elemental in the Vortex Pinnacle.
Wild Hammering is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing 5 dwarves in a single Twin Peaks battle.

The Wild Plains is a vast area west of Stormstout Brewery in southwestern Valley of the Four Winds. These plains are filled with mushan, foxes, and stags. To the southwest is Nesingwary's Safari, which overlooks the Dustback Gorge.
Wild Shaghornsare goats located in Valley of the Four Winds.
Wild Plains Yaks are yaks located in the Yaungol Advance in Kun-Lai Summit.
Wild Huntresses are level 85 tigers found in the Bamboo Wilds of the Jade Forest.
Wild Jade is gained from prospecting Ghost Iron Ore and alchemy transmute.
__NOTOC__ Wild Silkworms are silkworms located in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ There are two Wild Pterrorwing Hatchlings in the Diremoor of the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the hatchling has the adventurer gathering a Wild Pterrorwing Hatchling (item) item.
Wild Rider's Gloves are a quest reward from Mor'shan Caravan Delivery.
Wild Jade Hatchlings are level 25 dragonkin that can be captured for pet battles.
Wild Golden Hatchlings are level 25 dragonkin that can be captured for pet battles.
Wild Goregers are boars found in Brute's Rise in Ashran. These minor creatures are found in groups of 5-7.
Wild Goretusk can be purchased from at a cost of 1000 Blackfang Claw upon reaching reputation with the Saberstalkers.
Wild Imps are imps summoned by Hand of Gul'dan. They attack with Fel Firebolt.
Wild Olives are looted from Olive Sprigs in the Olivian Veil in Azsuna.
Wild Gladiator's Vestments is the Warlords Season 2 Rogue arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Felblood Gronnling is an achievement that is awarded for obtaining the Wild Gladiator's Felblood Gronnling in Warlords Season 2.
Wild Gladiator: Warlords Season 2 is an achievement awarded for ending Warlords PvP season 2 in the top 0.1% of the arena ladder (requires 50 games won in Warlords Season 2).
Wild Gladiator's Sanctuary is the Warlords Season 2 Druid arena set.
Wild Onyx Serpents are Cloud serpents found circling Mount Neverest in Kun-Lai Summit.
Wild Style is about collecting a full set of Warlords PvP Season 2 armor (including bracer, belt and boots) for one class.
Wild Gladiator's Vindication is the Warlords Season 2 paladin arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Wartide is the Warlords Season 2 shaman arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Felshroud is the Warlords Season 2 warlock arena set.
Wild Murky, while presumably made for Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl, was never made available.
Wild Kranzae is a Zandalari troll located in Dazar'alor. She transforms into a raptor and runs from Granda Watae in the Terrace of Crafters to Anji the Thundering the Zocalo.
Wild Mana Wand can be purchased from Dazzik "Proudmoore" in the Underbelly of Dalaran for .
Wild Pterrordax Hatchlings are pterrordax located in Zuldazar.
Wild Starcallers are worgen located on the Havenswood, Dread Chain, Rotting Mire, and Jorundall isles.
Wild Holly is the 2019's gift from Gently Shaken Gift. This item will transform your current mount into a Wild Reindeer.
Wild Shoveltusk are shoveltusk located in the Howling Fjord.
Wild Sparrowhawk is an hawk located at the Twilight Ridge in Nagrand.
__NOTOC__ Wild Sabertusks are sabertusks located in Rootway in Zuldazar.
Wild Winds are air elementals located at the Roiling Vortex in Nazjatar.
Wild Howler is a monkey summoned by [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=210753/aspect-of-the-monkey Aspect of the Monkey].
Wild Gormlings are gorm located in the Spirit Glen and the Dusty Burrows in Ardenweald.
Wild Gorm Gris drops from Gorm Spewers, Gorm Borers and Gorm Slicers in the Dusty Burrows in Ardenweald after the Gormherd Branch has been used on them.
Wild Hunt Supplies are a quest reward from Supplies from The Wild Hunt.
__NOTOC__ Wild Gloomrunners are cloudrunners located near Dreamsong Fenn in Ardenweald.
Wild Mistrunners are cloudrunners located in southern and western Ardenweald.

Wild Mandragoras are mandragoras located in Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Wild Nightsabers are nightsabers located in Val'sharah.
Wild Godrune is obtained through treasure chests in Ardenweald. They are also looted from Bounty of the Grove Wardens and Tribute of the Wild Hunt.

Wild Hunt Nightblades are sylvar located in Ardenweald. They were present during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Wild Hunt Guardians are vorkai located in Ardenweald. They were present during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Wild Hunt Enchanters are faeries located at the center of Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Wild Scorpids are amber scorpions located in the Venomsting Pits in the Assault on Zan'vess.
Wild Gladiator's Ringmail Kilt is awarded from Warlords Season 2. It is sold by Amelia Clarke in Stormshield for 3 Mark of Honor.
Wild Prairie Chickens are bush chickens that disguised themselves as Hillpaw's Chickens in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Wild Nightbloom Catalyst are plants planted with Wild Nightbloom in Anima Catalyst Plots in the Queen's Conservatory.
Wild Goat is a goat located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.

__NOTOC__ Wild Proto-Drakes are proto-dragons located in the Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, and Thaldraszus.
Wild Surges is a Balance druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Stellar Flare.

Wildvine is a Herb that can be gathered with Herbalism (210).

The Wildmane Water Well is located just north of Thunder Bluff. It is the northernmost of the tauren people's sacred water wells. This well had been taken over by the Venture Company in order to control the water supply but were run off by the tauren. Recently the Grimtotem tribe have been tainting the water supply as payback for being exiled from Thunder Bluff.
__NOTOC__ The Wildvine Potion can both heal and restore mana. However, the amount it restores is a random amount from 1 to 1500 for both.
The Wildmane Cleansing Totem is provided as an objective for Wildmane Cleansing and Wildmane Cleansing (Classic).

Wildfire Cape is a cloak that dropped in Upper Blackrock Spire. Before Cataclysm, it had a large amount of fire resistance but no additional stats. It had been great for characters newly venturing into the Molten Core, though not so useful to players gearing up for Outland by running dungeons.
Willey's Back Scratcher is a Level 42 quality One-Handed Fist Weapon that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Wildwind Lake is a stretch of water near Camp Mojache in the region of Feralas.
Wildkin E'ko is required for the quest Wildkin E'ko. You can turn in three of these for one Juju Guile.
Wildthorn Venomspitters are tarantulas found in eastern Ashenvale.
The Wildhammer Keep is a large keep inside Aerie Peak maintained by the Wildhammer dwarves. The keep is also used as an inn and there is an anvil but no forge within.

.]] icon.]] A wilderness stalker uses stealth to slip unseen and unheard through the woods and sneak in close to her prey. Born of instinct among the tauren and the trolls in ancient times, the way of the wilderness stalker has become a set of skills passed from one generation to another - and to the occasional ally, such as the orcs of the Horde. The mok'nathal have also developed the techniques of becoming wilderness stalkers - claiming the wilds of Azeroth, becoming true people of the land. A wilderness stalker emphasizes thrown weapons as well as bonding with the world around her. .]] Wildpaw Cavern is a cave located southeast of Frostwolf Village, in the top of a frozen waterfall next to the starting cave for Horde players. It is the proving grounds for Horde players who want to prove their allegiance to the Frostwolf clan. The cavern is filled with gnolls of the Wildpaw tribe.

The Wildpaw tribe is a tribe of gnolls who appear in the Alterac Valley battleground. They once controlled a large swath of land known as Wildpaw Ridge, but a huge avalanche buried it, killing most of their population. Currently, they live only in Wildpaw Cavern and are a nuisance to the Horde forces at Frostwolf Village. They may be allied with the Twilight's Hammer clan since a Twilight's Hammer banner can be seen inside their cave. Their only known named member is Grimtooth.
Wildthorn Lurkers are tarantulas found near the Warsong Labor Camp in southeastern Ashenvale.
__NOTOC__ Wildthorn Stalkers are tarantulas found near Astranaar in western Ashenvale. Their venom is fast-acting.
Willful Fire Opal is an epic gem that fits a red or yellow socket.
The Wildhammer Flare Gun is provided as an objective for The Path of Conquest (Alliance).

Wildwind Path is the long and winding path that leads up to Wildwind Peak. It is watched over by air elementals. Oddly, no crystal shards are on the path, despite Wildwind Peak being the impact site of the Exodar when it crash-landed on Azeroth.
Wildwood Chain is a quest reward from Reception from Tyrande.
Wildguard Breastplate is crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Wildguard Breastplate, a Cenarion Expedition reputation reward.
Wildguard Helm is crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Wildguard Helm, a Cenarion Expedition reputation reward.
Wildguard Leggings are crafted with Blacksmithing (375); taught by Plans: Wildguard Leggings, a Cenarion Expedition reputation reward.
Willey's Portable Howitzer is a Level 42 quality Gun that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
The Will of Edward the Odd is a world drop from mobs in zones. It is one of the lost belongings of Edward the Odd.
Wildkeeper Leggings are a quest reward from The Blackwood Corrupted.
Will of the Martyr is a quest reward from Aurius' Reckoning.

Wiley's Note is a quest item provided for The Defias Brotherhood (2) and The Defias Brotherhood (3). It was written by Wiley the Black for Gryan Stoutmantle as repayment for a favor. The note details what Wiley knows about the Defias Brotherhood's plans, and it must be brought first to Gryan in Westfall and then to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
A will-o'-wisp (aka will-o'-the-wisp) is a type of spirit that lives in the Twisting Nether. They travel as a string. It is known for how it vanishes.
Wildpaw Gnolls are gnolls located in Alterac Valley. Killing a Wildpaw Gnoll will result in +1 reputation with either the Stormpike Guard or the Frostwolf Clan.
William's Shipment is provided as an objective for Shipment to Stormwind.

The Wildmane clan is a tauren clan. They seem to have a strong connection to nature and specifically the animal kingdom, as many amongst them are druids, while others maintain their own connection to animals (training Wind Riders or making leather armor).
Wildspawn Shadowstalker are satyrs located in the eastern part of Dire Maul.
Wildspawn Felsworns are satyrs located in the eastern part of Dire Maul.
Wildspawn Betrayers are satyrs located in the eastern part of Dire Maul.
Wildspawn Rogues are satyrs located in the eastern part of Dire Maul.
Wildkin Feathers can be found throughout the western part of the Hinterlands.
William Dunadaire is found at the House of Edune in Ashenvale. Here he lives along with his sister and the Edune familiy. He seems to have a crush on Becanna Edune.
Wildervar Sentries are humans located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.
Wildervar Workers are humans and dwarves located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.
Wild Worgs are worgs located in the Bleeding Vale in the Howling Fjord.
William Allerton was a friend of Thassarian, his body is found at the Farshire Mine in the Borean Tundra.
"In days long past, we lived for the hunt. We hunted for glory, for honor... Is it so different now?"
Wildhammer Sentries are Wildhammer dwarves found at the stronghold of Aerie Peak, Stormfeather Outpost, and near Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.
Wilhelmina Renel is a Grand Master Alchemy trainer located at Vengeance Landing in the Howling Fjord.

__NOTOC__ William Saldean is a Forsaken bread vendor and herbalism trainer. He is the only Horde NPC to sell Special Chicken Feed, needed for the quest "CLUCK!". There are usually a few chickens around him.
The Wildscale Breastplate is crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (55); Taught by trainers.

Wilfred Fizzlebang is a gnome warlock located on the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown, where he is surrounded by Visiting Warlocks. He later appears in the Crusaders' Coliseum, where he attempts to summon a doomguard for the next challenge. He accidentally summons Lord Jaraxxus instead, who promptly kills him. During the Great Gnomeregan Run, the ghost of Wilfred Fizzlebang appears in Darkshire in Duskwood cheering at the participants.
__NOTOC__ Wild Wyrms can be found west of Dun Niffelem and is the quest target of How To Slay Your Dragon.
Wildervar Mine is a mine dug into Frostblade Peak by the humans of Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.

The Wildspawn are a group of satyrs which made Dire Maul east their home. They corrupted all plants and ancients in there, as well as the Fruit of Fertility to create Felvine Shards. Alzzin the Wildshaper is their leader, his chamber is guarded by Zevrim Thornhoof. They used to be druids. After the Fourth War, the satyrs are still present in the Warpwood Quarter, but Alzinn was killed by wandering adventurers years before the Fourth War.
Willem's Mitts are a quest reward from Ending the Invasion!.
Wildpaw Alphas are gnolls of the Wildpaw tribe found in Alterac Valley.
Wildpaw Brutes are gnolls of the Wildpaw tribe found in Alterac Valley.
Wildpaw Mystics are gnolls of the Wildpaw tribe found in Alterac Valley.
Wildpaw Shaman are gnolls of the Wildpaw tribe found in Alterac Valley.
Wildheart Point is a neutral outpost of the Emerald Circle a largely autonomous branch of the Cenarion Circle. Wildheart Point is located in Felwood east of Jaedenar.
The Wildhammer Riding Helm is a mail armor helmet that drops from General Umbriss in Grim Batol.
Wildhammer Ales are looted from Wildhammer Ale Casks near Dunwald Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
The Wildhammer Water Bucket is provided by Keegan Firebeard in Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands for The Only Homes We Have.
Wildhammer Food Stores are located near Thundermar in the Twilight Highlands.
__NOTOC__ Will Robotronic is a goblin quest giver located at the Ruins of Nordressa in Azshara along with the Image of Archmage Xylem and Xylem's apprentices.

Willey Hopebreaker, previously known as a scarlet crusader Cannon Master Willey, is an undead of the Risen in Stratholme.
Wildhammer Scribe's Band is a quest reward from Sacred to the Bloodscalp.
Wildhammer Book of Verse is contained in Treasures from Grim Batol, a quest reward from Soften them Up.
The Will of Unbinding drops from Spine of Deathwing in Dragon Soul.
Willard C. Bennington is a level 63 gilnean stable master for the Gilnean town of Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
__NOTOC__ Willard Harrington is a worgen blacksmithing supplies vendor located at the Talonbranch Glade in Felwood. He can be found within the tree, working with the anvil and forge nearby him.
Wildmane Cat Pelts drop from Wildmane Cats on Darkspear Isle in Durotar.
__NOTOC__ Wildmane Cats are lynxes found on the Darkspear Isle on the Echo Isles in Durotar. During the Fourth War, some of them were killed by Mindless Trolls.
Wilderland Stags are stags found in the Wild Plains in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Wilderland Does are deer found in the Wild Plains in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Will of the Emperor is the last boss in Mogu'shan Vaults. It is a dual-target add fight consisting of Qin-xi and Jan-xi. To start the fight on heroic mode, interact with the Ancient Mogu Pipes on the lower level.
__NOTOC__ Wildscale Saurok are saurok located in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Wildscale Herbalists are saurok located in Valley of the Four Winds.
Wildkin Spirits are ghosts of deceased wildkin found in Darkshore. They become friendly after the quest The Wildkin's Oath.

Wilds' Edge Inn is the inn of Zhu's Watch in northeast Krasarang Wilds. It is dirty and unkempt, with piles of refuse and broken junk strewn about. The proprietor is Rude Sho, who at first appears to be under the influence of the Sha of Despair, but is revealed to just be a naturally cranky fellow.
__NOTOC__ Wildhammer Gryphon Hatchlings are found near Kirthaven and Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
The Wildhammer Lookout is a nameless Wildhammer dwarf quest giver located at the Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands. He calls out aid against Shadra.

:Wild?! Now that's a surprise! Grandpa used to tell stories about having to wrestle his wild crops into submission. "Yoonie," he used to say, "don't be afraid to slap your scallions around." I always thought he was just being gross. — Wild crops occasionally spawn on Sunsong Ranch. They must be tamed before the crop will grow normally.

__NOTOC__ Will Larsons is a worgen battle pet trainer located near the center of Lor'danel in Darkshore. He is accompanied by his level 5 pet Gilnean Raven, Poe. He provides training for battle pets for .

__NOTOC__ Wildfowl Breast is an item that drops from many different birds throughout Pandaria. It is an ingredient in certain raid feasts and also in making Wildfowl Roast to increase reputation with Farmer Fung and Valley Stir Fry to increase reputation with Chee Chee, both of The Tillers. They can also be purchased from Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds; one Ironpaw Token purchases a Sack of Wildfowl Breasts which contains five of them.
__NOTOC__ Wildfowl Roast is created with Way of the Oven (525); taught by Jian Ironpaw in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Willard "Bubbles" Wilcox is a human found in Bizmo's Brawlpub underneath the Deeprun Tram.

:Thir aromatic broth, rich hearty noodles and topped with juicy duck meat, is lent a peppery bite by the ginger and chili. With just enough complexity to transcend rustic, this Valley of the Four Winds specialty is a warm and satisfying meal.

Wildblood Vest is crafted by Leatherworkers with a skill level of 600. Pattern: Wildblood Vest is sold by Jaluu the Generous in Mogu'shan Palace in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The pattern costs . You must be with the Golden Lotus to purchase this pattern.

Wildblood Gloves are crafted by Leatherworkers with a skill level of 600. Pattern: Wildblood Gloves is sold by Jaluu the Generous in Mogu'shan Palace in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The pattern costs . You must be with the Golden Lotus to purchase this pattern.

The Wildscale tribe of saurok are found in the eastern areas of Winds' Edge in the Valley of the Four Winds and Krasarang Wilds. Due to the sha the pandaren of Zhu's Watch have lost some control over Zhu Province, making it possible for the saurok to move into the cave north of the town from the forest.

Wildvine Marsh lies between Zeb'tula / Dawnseeker Promontory and the Diremoor on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. After Dawnseeker Promontory is established, the area is mostly taken over by the Horde and Sunreaver Perimeter Wards are put up.
__NOTOC__ Wildhammer Raiders are Wildhammer dwarves found at the Krazzworks of the Twilight Highlands.

The Will of Northrend is a toy that is inspired by the transformations of Deathbringer's Will (from Deathbringer Saurfang's Deathbringer's Cache in Icecrown Citadel). You will be randomly transformed into a taunka, vrykul or iron dwarf.

William "Bill" King is a British author of science fiction and fantasy works, most known for his work in the Warhammer settings. He is the author of the Warcraft novel Illidan. King has been familiar with Illidan as early as Warcraft III, and has cited Illidan and Arthas Menethil as the most interesting characters in Warcraft lore. William King played the first RTS games, and has been playing World of Warcraft since the Burning Crusade expansion. He plays both factions and a rogue.
Using a Wildswater on a Stone of Fire creates a Stone of the Wilds.

The Wildwood is a small woodland found in Val'sharah. It is full of wandering stags. Crazed bears corrupted by the nightmare have found their way here. A small pond and a ransacked home with two dead night elven druids can be found in the upper part of this area.
__NOTOC__ Wildfowl Eggs usually drop from the birds on the Broken Isles.
Wildscale Poachers are saurok found roaming at the Rumbling Terrace and Winds' Edge in the Valley of the Four Winds. Occasionally, they are seen tearing the flesh off of Sungraze Mushan.
Will of the First King is an Arms warrior major artifact trait. It is linked to the Crushing Blows and Exploit the Weakness traits.
Willbreaker Legguards drop from Moroes in the Return to Karazhan.
Wilderness Stalker's Softsoles drop from Attumen the Huntsman in the Return to Karazhan.
Wiley's Wicked Ale is found in Ratchet during the Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl event. When you drink it, you turn a ghostly red.
Wildhammer Shaman are Wildhammer dwarves located in the Hinterlands.
Wildhammer Stormtalons are gryphons located in the Krazzworks in Twilight Highlands. They are ridden by Stormtalon Riders.
Wildeyed Undergrell are grells located in Grizzleweald of Val'sharah.

Wildhammer Homesteaders are Wildhammer dwarves located within the Thundermar Ruins in the Twilight Highlands. They are being held in the basement of a dwarven house by Twilight Hammer priest Korthalon the Black.
William O'Connor is an artist who contributed artwork for the World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game.
__NOTOC__ Wildwood Mongrels are wicker beasts located at the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.

Will Melborne is the Ferry Master of Boralus, found in Tradewinds Market. His daughter Sally stands behind him. Players who have a Ferry Pass can get free rides to locations along Kul Tiras' interior coastline.
Wildhammer Warriors are Wildhammer dwarves located in the Hinterlands.
Will Hairris is a house cat located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Willbreaker Incubators are located in Sashj'tar Ruins in Suramar.
Will of the Illidari is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Honed Warblades and Devour Souls traits.
Will of the Conclave is a Discipline priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Lenience's Reward trait.
Wildflesh is a Guardian druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Bear Hug, Iron Claws, and Perpetual Spring traits.
Wildtusk Ivory Headcracker is a quest reward from Headhunter Jo (quest).
The Wildguard item collection is awarded from completing world quests in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. Though not a proper set (with no set bonuses), all nine pieces share a name:
